title: Preamble Section-Header Banners
pattern: Noisy, visual-heavy banner comments dividing a file into arbitrary sections like 'Actions', 'Getters', or 'Setters'.
why_bad: Adds visual clutter that breaks scanning. It encourages files to grow too large by grouping unrelated tasks instead of splitting files.
detection: Comments containing long lines of decorative characters (`// ===`, `// ***`, `// ---`) wrapping simple labels.
counterexample: Minimal, non-decorative division comments in highly complex state-machine files.
fix: Remove the banner comment entirely; structure the file cleanly and rely on IDE outlines.
source: Robert C. Martin, *Clean Code* (2008), Chapter 4 ("Comments - Position Markers"), p. 67.
